scope: All authored Markdown guides; launch and folder-layout references, status/historical boundaries, local links/anchors and npm script names. Targeted content review supplements the mechanical checks; this is not a new verification of every native reverse-engineering claim.
findingsFixed: Editable port module references now use source; generated runtime paths remain src.
Normal browser and desktop launch guides now describe automatic runtime refresh and the absence of a live watcher.
Added source/test purpose guides and a central folder guide, distinguishing the native original-source reference.
Browser inspection documentation uses explicit --inspect-source; normal game loading remains bundled.
Version instructions now reference source/version.js and regeneration rather than copying standalone version modules.
Removed stale import-map/direct-source startup claims from current hosting and desktop instructions.
Corrected HUD canvas description to layout-only; actual HUD pixels use opaque RGB565 composition.
Electron download is attributed to npm ci, not the first game launch.
Clarified historical source-only publication and recovery-delivery notes after the later 0.9.0 desktop release.
Frozen checkpoint verification commands and old src hashes remain explicitly historical.
Startup RNG consumer note now links implemented construction-order integration instead of implying an open task.
